state.persona: A guest invited by a friend; opens the friend's link on an iPhone in a demo build of dope.travel (simulated members, labelled 'Demo · simulated' in the header).
state.job: Understand the invitation and accept a seat in the friend's cabin.
state.visible: The event panel for Mara River Crossings fills most of the screen. Floating over its lower half and overlapping the bottom tab bar is a box: YOU WERE SENT THIS. Long Weekend — Masai Mara. MARA RIVER CROSSINGS · MASAI MARA · 26 JUL – 30 SEP 2026 (small faint caps). Then a very narrow column where the text wraps one word per line: 'Marius / Oyelaran / is / hosting. / 3/6 / aboard' — the last line is partly hidden behind the tab bar. To its right: 'Not this time' (plain text button) and 'Take a seat — 3 left' (dark rounded button, not the bright primary style).

understands_host.instructions: Probability the guest correctly understands who is hosting and how many seats are taken.

accept_clear.instructions: How clear is it how to accept?
